primary.title: Fixed Deposits: Can you save tax on FD interest? Key rules every depositor should know
primary.summary: Interest earned on fixed deposits is treated as ‘Income from Other Sources’ under income tax rules. It gets added to your total annual income and taxed according to the income tax slab applicable to you.
